subject: mathematics
concept: Telling time to the hour and half-hour on an analog clock
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student moves virtual clock hands to show a stated time
exercise.pictorial: Student reads a pictured clock face and writes the time shown
exercise.abstract: Student matches written times to their correct clock position

misconception_flags: confuses the hour hand and minute hand

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
